title: AWS or Azure: Choosing a Primary Cloud for an Enterprise
excerpt: The two largest public clouds compared on what usually decides the matter for IT teams: breadth and maturity of services, and how easily each fits an organisation already running Microsoft identity and productivity tools.
verdict: AWS offers the broadest and most mature catalogue of cloud services and is a strong general-purpose choice. Azure is the natural fit for organisations already built on Active Directory and Microsoft 365, where integration is simpler and licensing benefits can lower cost.
